title: Austin Confronts State Immigration Law SB4
summary:
*   Austin leaders held a press conference at the Texas Capitol to address Senate Bill 4.
*   The discussion centered on the state law concerning local governmental enforcement of immigration laws.
*   City officials highlighted the plan for the City Manager to pursue legal action against Senate Bill 4.
*   This gathering was for public discussion and press engagement only, with no formal council action taken at this meeting.
